meta.tagline: Compare how outlets across the spectrum cover the same story
meta.description: News grouped by story, with coverage split by left, center and right outlets, in English and Khmer.

coverage.unrated: {count, plural, =1 {+1 not rated} other {+# not rated}}

blindspot.title: Blindspot
blindspot.subtitle: Stories covered heavily by one side of the political spectrum and barely, or not at all, by the other.
blindspot.leftDesc: Stories that had little or no reporting from left-leaning outlets.
blindspot.rightDesc: Stories that had little or no reporting from right-leaning outlets.
blindspot.empty: No blindspots in the current feed. Check back after the next refresh.
blindspot.about: A story is a blindspot when at least three rated outlets covered it and one side has none of them while the other has most. Center outlets count towards the total but not towards either side.

home.briefingStats: {stories, plural, =1 {1 story} other {# stories}} • {articles, plural, =1 {1 article} other {# articles}} • {minutes} min read
home.briefingIntro: Today's most widely covered stories, in one read.
home.feedStats: {articles, plural, =1 {1 article} other {# articles}} from {outlets, plural, =1 {1 outlet} other {# outlets}}
home.feedsUnavailable: {count, plural, =1 {1 feed unavailable} other {# feeds unavailable}}
home.empty: No stories yet. Feeds may still be loading or unreachable.
home.demoBanner: Demo mode: showing sample articles from the fixtures, not live news.

category.title: {category}
category.empty: No {category} stories in the current feed yet. Stories are classified by what the outlets filed and the words in their coverage, so this section fills up as the day's news comes in.

story.centerText: Center-rated outlets anchor the neutral summary above. Compare it with the Left and Right tabs to see what each side emphasised.
story.noLeft: No left-leaning outlets in our list covered this story.
story.noRight: No right-leaning outlets in our list covered this story.
story.noFraming: Framing is only written when the AI summary is available.
story.aiNote: Summary and framing written by AI from the articles below.
story.extractiveNote: Summary taken from the article most typical of the story.
story.showingEnglish: Showing the English text until the next refresh.
story.comingSoonText: We do not have factuality or ownership data for outlets yet, and we will not invent any.
story.notFoundText: This story is no longer in the current feed. Stories stay for about two days.
story.unratedNote: {count, plural, =1 {1 outlet} other {# outlets}} without a bias rating also covered this story.

local.title: Local
local.subtitle: Top stories for {location}
local.chooseTitle: Choose a location for a local feed
local.chooseText: Read the stories outlets are covering about one country, including outlets based there.
local.detected: Detected from your connection. Change it any time.
local.empty: We do not have local coverage for {location} yet.
local.emptyText: No story in the current feed was filed by an outlet based there or is mostly about it. The feed refreshes every 30 minutes.
local.khmerCoverageText: Recent reports from Khmer-language outlets. They are listed on their own because stories are grouped from English-language coverage only.
local.khmerEmpty: No Khmer-language reports in the last two days.
local.noOutlets: We do not follow any outlets based in {location} yet, so local stories come from international coverage.

forYou.title: For You
forYou.subtitle: Stories from the topics and outlets you follow.
forYou.empty: Follow some topics or outlets to build your feed.
forYou.savedLocally: Saved on this device. Accounts with synced follows are coming soon.
forYou.noMatches: None of today's stories match what you follow yet. Try following a broader topic.
forYou.followingCount: Following {topics, plural, =0 {no topics} =1 {1 topic} other {# topics}} and {outlets, plural, =0 {no outlets} =1 {1 outlet} other {# outlets}}

sources.title: Sources and bias ratings
sources.intro: Each outlet has one rating, approximated from public media-bias charts such as AllSides and Ad Fontes Media. A story's coverage bar counts how many outlets from each side reported it, so several feeds from one outlet count once.
sources.unratedIntro: Outlets those charts do not cover are shown as "Not rated". They appear in stories and on the Local page but are left out of the left, center and right percentages.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Search headlines, summaries and outlet names in English or Khmer.
search.none: Nothing matched “{query}”. Try a shorter word or an outlet name.

account.title: Accounts are coming soon
account.text: For now the topics you follow, your language and your location are saved on this device. Sign in and synced follows are the next step.

footer.tagline: Compare how outlets across the spectrum cover the same story, in English and Khmer.
footer.ratingsNote: Bias ratings are approximate and based on public charts. Cambodian outlets are not rated.
footer.howItWorksText: Articles from {outlets} outlets are grouped by story every 30 minutes. Summaries are written by AI from the articles and checked against nothing else, so read the originals.
footer.copyright: © {year} Freedom News. Headlines and article text belong to their publishers.
